name: Naphthenic oils (petroleum), catalytic dewaxed light; Baseoil - unspecified; [A complex combination of hydrocarbons obtained from a catalytic dewaxing process. It consists of hydrocarbons having carbon numbers predominantly in the range of C15 through C30 and produces a finished oil with a viscosity less than 100 SUS at 100 °F (19cSt at 40 °C). It contains relatively few normal paraffins.]
